articles.title: Forget Space Tunnels — Einstein's 'Wormhole' Is Really a Mirror That Flips Time
articles.summary: Wormholes aren't cosmic shortcuts; they're time mirrors. New research reinterprets Einstein and Rosen's 1935 'bridge' as a link between forward and backward arrows of time — a concept that could resolve the black hole information paradox without exotic physics. It's a hidden symmetry at the heart of spacetime.

articles.title: Starship V3 Reaches Space on First Flight, Despite Booster Crash and Engine Losses
articles.summary: SpaceX's massive Starship Version 3 — a complete design overhaul standing 408 feet tall — flew for the first time on Friday. The suborbital test saw engine failures and the Super Heavy booster crash into the Gulf, but the upper stage reached space and deployed 22 Starlink simulators, capturing spectacular orbital video.

articles.title: A Closed Hospital, a Fatal Heart Attack, and a $50 Billion Fund That Can't Help
articles.summary: Stanley Sears died after a heart attack in rural Martin County, N.C., a year after its only hospital closed. His sister Debra Pierce wonders if a nearby ER could have saved him. A $50 billion rural health fund offers no relief — because the hospital isn't open. The county now plans to spend $1.5 million on paramedic units.
